name: SUMMIT
subtitle: Extreme sports.
standfirst: People who have organised their lives around ground that gives nothing back.
introduction: SUMMIT follows climbers, alpinists, skiers and the people who spend their lives close to mountains — not for the summits themselves, but for what the pursuit of them asks of a life. The training, the waiting, the weather, the money, the friends who did not come back.
The series is being made now. Entries will appear here as the work is finished.

cover.alt: A figure standing at the edge of a snowfield in flat afternoon light.
